title: Match of the Day
synopsis_short: Highlights of five Premier League matches, including champions Arsenal's trip to Brighton.
synopsis_medium: Highlights of five Premier League matches, including Arsenal v Brighton, Tottenham v Aston Villa, Everton v Ipswich, Newcastle v Hull and Nottingham Forest v Coventry.
synopsis_long: Highlights of five Premier League matches, including champions Arsenal's trip to Brighton. Spurs play Aston Villa, Everton host Ipswich, Newcastle welcome Hull to St James’ Park, and Nottingham Forest face Coventry. Plus Friday’s west London derby between Brentford and Chelsea.
synopsis_editorial: With Brighton v Arsenal, Newcastle v Hull and Spurs v Villa with both after a first win
